_comment: All dimensions in mm. Fancy pen holder — base tray + lid.

lid._comment: Lid shares body width/depth/fillet. Only height differs.

_magnet_pockets_comment: Shallow cylindrical cutouts on the bottom face of each corner to inset neodymium disc magnets. inset is distance from each corner edge to the cylinder center.
_slot_types_comment: Reusable slot templates. Each slot in the layout references one of these by type name. Rectangular prism cutouts: width is across the slot, depth is how deep the trough cuts down from the top surface. slot_fillet rounds the vertical edges of every slot.
_pen_slots_comment: Origin (0,0) is the bottom-left corner of the body footprint viewed from above. Horizontal slots run along +X, vertical slots run along +Y. type references a key in slot_types.
